topic: Day 114 — reel — Trust doesn't require certainty, just enough evidence to take the risk
text:
Trust isn't
certainty.
It's a decided [risk].
caption:
Waiting for proof that can't exist guarantees never trusting anyone. It's a choice made with incomplete information, on purpose.
